links.comparator_used: Concise definition-based prompt (Engel/ILAE definitions only) versus context-aware prompt adding temporal, causal and adherence logic, using GPT-4-turbo
links.outcome: Exact agreement with human-adjudicated consensus for Engel subclass and ILAE category scoring, plus ordinal distance
links.effect: Engel exact agreement 56.5% (95% CI 49.0-63.7) to 94.7% (95% CI 90.2-97.2); ILAE exact agreement 60.6% (95% CI 53.1-67.6) to 93.5% (95% CI 88.8-96.3); lower ordinal distance on both scales (paired sign tests p < .001)
links.quote: The context-aware prompt improved exact agreement to 94.7% for Engel (95% CI = 90.2-97.2) and 93.5% for ILAE (95% CI = 88.8-96.3), with lower ordinal distance for both scales (paired sign tests p < .001).

links.outcome: Exact Engel subclass agreement, exact ILAE agreement, and ordinal distance against human-adjudicated consensus
links.effect: Definition-based prompt: 56.5% exact Engel subclass agreement (95% CI = 49.0-63.7) and 60.6% exact ILAE agreement (95% CI = 53.1-67.6); context-aware prompt: 94.7% for Engel (95% CI = 90.2-97.2) and 93.5% for ILAE (95% CI = 88.8-96.3), with lower ordinal distance for both scales (paired sign tests p < .001).
links.quote: The context-aware prompt improved exact agreement to 94.7% for Engel (95% CI = 90.2-97.2) and 93.5% for ILAE (95% CI = 88.8-96.3), with lower ordinal distance for both scales (paired sign tests p < .001).
